title: Israeli Strikes Kill 6 in Khan Younis, Al-Mawasi, and Gaza City
detail: A drone strike on a vehicle on al-Rashid Street in Khan Younis killed at least 2 Palestinians; an attack on a displaced-persons tent in the al-Mawasi 'humanitarian zone' near Khan Younis killed 2 more; and a drone strike on an apartment in Gaza City killed a married couple. Separately, Israeli drone fire offshore wounded 3 Palestinian fishermen. At least 6 were killed and 22 wounded across the strikes. Gaza's Ministry of Health said ceasefire violations since October 2025 had killed 1,072 people and wounded 3,463, with the cumulative toll since October 7, 2023 at approximately 73,098 killed and 173,571 injured.

media.caption: Mourners carry the body of a Palestinian killed in an Israeli attack on an apartment in Gaza City — July 6, 2026

title: Hamas Dissolves Gaza Governing Body, Transfers Power to UN-Backed Technocratic Committee
detail: Hamas announced the dissolution of the Government Emergency Committee, the body that has run Gaza's civil affairs for nearly two decades. Mohammed al-Farra, the committee's head, submitted his resignation, and Hamas said it would transfer civilian administration to the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG), the technocratic body created under the US-backed Board of Peace plan and headed by Dr. Ali Sha'ath. Hamas said the move does not mean relinquishing its political or military role, only 'stepping back' from direct civilian government. Israel has not yet allowed NCAG members to enter Gaza.

media.caption: Hamas government media office head Ismail al-Thawabta announces dissolution of the Gaza governing body at Al-Aqsa Hospital, Deir el-Balah — July 6, 2026
